name: Sleeping Queens
summary: Card game where players use kings to wake point-valued queens and use knights and potions to steal or re-hide rivals' queens.
rules_text: Place 12 queen cards face down as sleeping queens. Shuffle remaining cards, deal 5 to each player, rest as draw pile, discard adjacent. On your turn take one action then refill hand to 5: Play a King to take any sleeping queen face up; if it is Rose Queen (5 pts) take a second sleeping queen. Play a Knight to steal an opponent's awake queen, but opponent may immediately discard a Dragon to cancel both and both draw. Play Sleeping Potion to return opponent's queen face down to center, but opponent may immediately discard a Wand to cancel both. Play Jester: reveal top of draw pile; if power card add to hand and take another turn, if number card count that many players clockwise from you and that player wakes a queen. Or discard 1 any card to draw 1, or discard a pair of identical numbers to draw 2, or discard 3+ numbers forming a valid addition equation to draw that many. Cat and Dog queens cannot coexist; if you gain the second you must return it face down. First to 5 queens or 50 pts (2-3p) or 4 queens or 40 pts (4-5p) wins; if center empties, most points wins.
